googlePlayForegroundServiceDemonstration.purpose: Demonstrate the user-initiated location foreground-service use case implemented by the exact signed Android candidate without exposing real employee/customer data.
preconditions: final production-signed Android candidate is installed
synthetic review credential/device access is operational
no real employee, customer, route, address, phone, pay or precise production-location data is visible
screen recording excludes passwords, one-time tokens, QR secrets, recovery values and signing credentials
device/system time and notification surface are visible enough to establish sequence

requiredSequence.proof: Show Paradise Performance before Start My Day with no active workday and no Paradise location foreground-service notification.

From the visible app foreground, the synthetic employee intentionally invokes Start My Day. If location or notification permission is not already granted, show the system permission flow without exposing unrelated device data.
Show the active-workday state and the visible Paradise Performance foreground-service notification indicating shift location is active.
Background the app while the active workday remains in progress and show that the visible foreground-service notification remains present.

Where the review device permits clean recording, lock and unlock the device during the active workday and show the foreground-service notification remains associated with the active shift. This step proves the intended user-visible service state, not a blanket physical-device acceptance PASS.
Return to Paradise Performance and show the same active workday still in progress. Do not expose precise synthetic coordinates unless needed for the declaration.
Invoke Finish Day from the app and show the completed-workday state.

Show that the Paradise Performance location foreground-service notification is removed after Finish Day/stop. Attach a redacted platform readback if needed to prove the service/location updates stopped.

separateTechnicalReadback: signed artifact SHA-256 and non-secret signing identity/fingerprint are recorded
googlePlayForegroundServiceDemonstration.failureRule: If any required step cannot be demonstrated on the exact signed candidate, keep the video URL BLOCKED and do not submit the foreground-service declaration as complete.
